text: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.
Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zenza umsebenzi wazo.
Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.
Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: indlu yotshani, umlilo, kuphelile.
Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.
